skuPolicy.maxUnifiedMemoryGB: SKU maximum among explicitly confirmed example Macs; use memoryLimitsByMac when model is known; family maximum can be historical
skuPolicy.uniqueMatch: brand + named CPU physical tiers/total + GPU; Metal is optional corroboration and must not conflict; unknown topology or multiple candidates does not justify guessing
